name: waymark-workers
description: Cloudflare Workers + D1 port of the Waymark control and content servers.

scripts.deploy:control: npm run generate:theme && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.control.toml
scripts.deploy:content: npm run generate:theme && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.content.toml
scripts.d1:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply waymark --local -c wrangler.control.toml
scripts.d1:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply waymark --remote -c wrangler.control.toml
